items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who did, do you remember who saw Sam Gartman in this place? [INTERVIEWEE] A fellow who is in California now by the name of Pearson.

ctx.x: I remember when Paul left because Paul was with us and he left.
Yeah. Mm-hmm. Who did, do you remember who saw Sam Gartman in this place?
A fellow who is in California now by the name of Pearson.
